scope.owned_layer: ProjectionStore synchronous connect, statement, and lock timeout bounds with thread-level deadline enforcement, custom connector fallback timeout handling with strict TypeError propagation, and lifecycle worker failure recording.

Quarantine and receipt claiming relational semantics
Public telemetry schema and event contracts

contracts.synchronous_store_bounds: ProjectionStore implements finite positive connect_timeout_seconds, statement_timeout_seconds, and lock_timeout_seconds (defaulting to 10.0s), configuring PostgreSQL libpq connect_timeout and session options statement_timeout and lock_timeout at connection initialization, strictly bounding all connect attempts (including custom connectors and fallbacks) using a dedicated worker thread with timeout deadline, and avoiding broad TypeError retries by only falling back on keyword argument mismatches.
contracts.timeout_configuration: _configured_relational_projector binds environment variables LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_PROJECTION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_PROJECTION_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_PROJECTION_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, and LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_PROJECTION_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (with fallback to LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_DB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS or 10.0s), rejecting non-finite, non-positive, or boolean inputs.
contracts.worker_resilience: Lifecycle worker catches synchronous query/lock/connect timeouts during startup and batch execution, publishing failure/degraded status to the durable controller via _record_worker_failure without process hanging, premature checkpoint advance, or deadlock.
